module.purpose: Defines the Zod validation schemas for booking creation request bodies in Cal.com. It provides the core schema used by the internal booking flow, an extended schema for recurring bookings and app statuses, a schema exposing legacy API props now covered by dynamic `responses`, and the final merged schema used by the public booking API. The `responses` field is merged in later at handleNewBooking time because it is dynamic per eventType.
module.summary: This file is the validation layer for creating bookings in the Cal.com scheduling platform. It defines `bookingCreateBodySchema` covering essential booking fields: event type identification (id/slug), start/end times, timezone, language, user(s), metadata, hashed booking links, seat references, org/team slugs, CRM ownership fields, routing form data, dry-run and cache flags, UTM tracking, dub id, and creation source. `extendedBookingCreateBody` merges in recurring-booking fields (recurringCount, allRecurringDates, currentRecurringIndex), app status reporting, luckyUsers, and legacy customInputs. `bookingCreateSchemaLegacyPropsForApi` captures legacy fields (email, name, guests, notes, location, smsReminderNumber, rescheduleReason, customInputs) that the public API may still send but which now live in dynamic `responses`. `bookingCreateBodySchemaForApi` merges everything into the schema consumed by the booking API endpoint. Downstream, `handleNewBooking` merges the eventType-specific `responses` schema into these schemas before validation.
module.businessContext: Cal.com booking scheduling: every new or rescheduled booking request passes through these schemas. Invalid validation blocks all booking creation, rescheduling, routing-form rerouting, and CRM-attributed bookings.

units.name: bookingCreateBodySchema
units.source:
export const bookingCreateBodySchema = z.object({
  end: z.string().optional(),
  eventTypeId: z.number(),
  eventTypeSlug: z.string().optional(),
  rescheduleUid: z.string().optional(),
  recurringEventId: z.string().optional(),
  rescheduledBy: z.string().email({ message: "Invalid email" }).optional(),
  start: z.string(),
  timeZone: timeZoneSchema,
  user: z.union([z.string(), z.array(z.string())]).optional(),
  language: z.string(),
  bookingUid: z.string().optional(),
  metadata: z.record(z.string()),
  hasHashedBookingLink: z.boolean().optional(),
  hashedLink: z.string().nullish(),
  seatReferenceUid: z.string().optional(),
  orgSlug: z.string().optional(),
  teamMemberEmail: z.string().nullish(),
  crmOwnerRecordType: z.string().nullish(),
  crmRecordId: z.string().nullish(),
  routedTeamMemberIds: z.array(z.number()).nullish(),
  routingFormResponseId: z.number().optional(),
  skipContactOwner: z.boolean().optional(),
  crmAppSlug: z.string().nullish().optional(),
  cfToken: z.string().nullish().optional(),

  /**
   * Holds the corrected responses of the Form for a booking, provided during rerouting
   */
  reroutingFormResponses: routingFormResponseInDbSchema.optional(),
  /**
   * Used to identify if the booking is a dry run.
   */
  _isDryRun: z.boolean().optional(),
  /** Whether to override the cache */
  _shouldServeCache: z.boolean().optional(),
  tracking: z
    .object({
      utm_source: z.string().optional(),
      utm_medium: z.string().optional(),
      utm_campaign: z.string().optional(),
      utm_term: z.string().optional(),
      utm_content: z.string().optional(),
    })
    .optional(),
  dub_id: z.string().nullish(),
  creationSource: z.nativeEnum(CreationSource).optional(),
});
